integrity: A complete symbolic proof and independent combinatorial enumeration script are provided; no independent external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only stacked simplicial 3-spheres and their first simplicial double. Nonstacked spheres, higher tuplings, and equivariance unproved. Earlier results may use alternate opposite-edge terminology; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Five new circles per stacking in simplicial doubles of three-spheres
